title: Back-to-back Russian drone strikes kill more than a dozen at Ukraine shopping centre
summary: A pair of Russian drone strikes that hit a shopping centre in the Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih Friday killed at least 15 people and wounded scores more, authorities said.
